props.custom_logic_action:
const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][Swordbreak]";

/* =========================

* Tuning knobs

* ========================= */

const PROC_CHANCE = 25; // 100 for now; lower later if you want

const REQUIRE_ATTACK_LIKE_ACTION = true;

// If your game labels normal attacks differently, edit these:

const ALLOWED_SOURCE_TYPES = ["attack"];

const ALLOWED_SKILL_TYPES = ["attack", "weapon"];

const PLAY_SOUND_ON_SUCCESS = true;

const SOUND_URL = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/LongSword1.ogg";

const BANE_EFFECT_UUID = "Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.n0OxEa26nnGFsoRO";

// Duplicate guard

const SKIP_IF_TARGET_ALREADY_HAS_BANE = true;

const FLAG_NS = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const FLAG_KEY = "swordbreakSourceUuid";

/* =========================

* Small helpers

* ========================= */

const p = payload ?? __PAYLOAD ?? {};

p.meta = p.meta || {};

const log = (...a) => (context?.log ? context.log (...a) : console.log (TAG, ...a));

const warn = (...a) => (context?.warn ? context.warn(...a) : console.warn(TAG, ...a));

const str = (v, d = "") => {

const s = String(v ?? "").trim();

return s.length ? s : d;

};

const low = (v, d = "") => str(v, d).toLowerCase();

function quietStop(reason = "Swordbreak stopped.", { hideCard = true } = {}) {

p.meta.__abortPipeline = true;

p.meta.__abortReason = String(reason);

p.meta.__abortNotify = false;

// Only hide passive visuals when we WANT to hide them.

p.meta.hidePassiveCard = !!hideCard;

p.meta.passiveCardHidden = !!hideCard;

p.meta.suppressPassiveCardUI = !!hideCard;

log("STOP", {

reason,

hideCard

});

return { ok: false, skipped: true, reason };

}

async function resolveDoc(uuidOrDoc) {

if (!uuidOrDoc) return null;

if (typeof uuidOrDoc !== "string") return uuidOrDoc;

try {

return await fromUuid(uuidOrDoc);

} catch (e) {

warn("resolveDoc failed", { uuidOrDoc, error: String(e?.message ?? e) });

return null;

}

}

function coerceActor(doc) {

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.documentName === "Actor" || doc.constructor?.name === "Actor") return doc;

if (doc.actor) return doc.actor;

if (doc.object?.actor) return doc.object.actor;

if (doc.token?.actor) return doc.token.actor;

if (doc.document?.actor) return doc.document.actor;

return null;

}

async function resolveActor(uuidOrDoc) {

const doc = await resolveDoc(uuidOrDoc);

return coerceActor(doc);

}

async function resolveTokenDoc(uuidOrDoc) {

const doc = await resolveDoc(uuidOrDoc);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.documentName === "Token" || doc.documentName === "TokenDocument") {

return doc;

}

if (doc.object?.document?.documentName === "Token") {

return doc.object.document;

}

const actor = coerceActor(doc);

if (actor) {

try {

const active = actor.getActiveTokens?.()?.[0] ?? null;

if (active?.document) return active.document;

} catch (_) {}

try {

const proto = actor.token?.document ?? actor.prototypeToken ?? null;

if (proto?.documentName === "Token" || proto?.documentName === "TokenDocument") return proto;

} catch (_) {}

}

return null;

}

function randomPercentRoll() {

return Math.floor(Math.random() * 100) + 1; // 1..100

}

function sameUuid(a, b) {

return !!a && !!b && String(a) === String(b);

}

function isAttackLikeTrigger(phase) {

if (!REQUIRE_ATTACK_LIKE_ACTION) return true;

const sourceType =

low(phase?.sourceType) ||

low(phase?.actionContext?.meta?.sourceType);

const skillType =

low(phase?.skillTypeRaw) ||

low(phase?.skill_type) ||

low(phase?.actionContext?.core?.skillTypeRaw) ||

low(phase?.actionContext?.dataCore?.skillTypeRaw) ||

low(phase?.actionContext?.meta?.skillTypeRaw);

return ALLOWED_SOURCE_TYPES.includes(sourceType) || ALLOWED_SKILL_TYPES.includes(skillType);

}

async function showPassiveCard(title = null) {

const passiveCardApi =

globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.passiveCard?.broadcast ??

globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.passiveCardBroadcast ??

null;

if (typeof passiveCardApi !== "function") {

warn("Swordbreak: passive card API missing; visual skipped.");

return false;

}

try {

await passiveCardApi({

title: title || p?.core?.skillName || p?.dataCore?.skillName || "Passive",

attackerUuid: ownerTokenDoc?.uuid ?? ownerActor?.uuid ?? ownerActorLikeUuid ?? ownerTokenLikeUuid ?? null,

actionContext: p,

options: {

executionMode: "autoPassive",

holdMs: 1600,

yOffset: 8

}

});

log("PASSIVE CARD broadcast success", {

title: title || p?.core?.skillName || p?.dataCore?.skillName || "Passive",

performer: ownerActor?.name ?? null

});

return true;

} catch (e) {

warn("Swordbreak: passive card broadcast failed.", e);

return false;

}

}

/* =========================

* Read original miss trigger

* ========================= */

const phaseByTrigger =

p?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload_by_trigger ??

p?.reaction_phase_payload_by_trigger ??

{};

const phase =

phaseByTrigger?.creature_miss_action ??

p?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload ??

p?.reaction_phase_payload ??

{};

log("START", {

passiveSkill: p?.core?.skillName ?? p?.dataCore?.skillName ?? null,

ownerAttackerUuid: p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attacker_uuid ?? null,

phase

});

/* =========================

* Resolve passive owner

* In autoPassive payload, attackerUuid is the passive owner's token/actor

* ========================= */

const ownerTokenLikeUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attacker_uuid ??

null;

const ownerActorLikeUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerActorUuid ??

p?.attackerActorUuid ??

ownerTokenLikeUuid ??

null;

const ownerActor = await resolveActor(ownerActorLikeUuid);

const ownerTokenDoc = await resolveTokenDoc(ownerTokenLikeUuid ?? ownerActorLikeUuid);

if (!ownerActor) {

return quietStop("Swordbreak: could not resolve passive owner.", { hideCard: true });

}

/* =========================

* Resolve original trigger data

* For creature_miss_action:

* - attacker/source side = the creature who missed

* - target side = the creature that was missed

* ========================= */

const triggerAttackerUuid =

phase?.attackerUuid ??

phase?.sourceUuid ??

phase?.sourceTokenUuid ??

phase?.subjectTokenUuid ??

phase?.tokenUuid ??

null;

const triggerAttackerActorUuid =

phase?.attackerActorUuid ??

phase?.sourceActorUuid ??

phase?.subjectActorUuid ??

phase?.actorUuid ??

null;

const triggerTargetUuid =

phase?.targetUuid ??

phase?.targetTokenUuid ??

(Array.isArray(phase?.targets) ? phase.targets[0] : null) ??

null;

const triggerTargetActorUuid =

phase?.targetActorUuid ??

(Array.isArray(phase?.targetActorUuids) ? phase.targetActorUuids[0] : null) ??

null;

log("TRIGGER CONTEXT", {

ownerActor: ownerActor?.name ?? null,

ownerTokenUuid: ownerTokenDoc?.uuid ?? null,

triggerAttackerUuid,

triggerAttackerActorUuid,

triggerTargetUuid,

triggerTargetActorUuid,

sourceType: phase?.sourceType ?? null,

skillTypeRaw: phase?.skillTypeRaw ?? phase?.skill_type ?? null

});

/* =========================

* Gate 1: original action must be attack-like

* ========================= */

if (!isAttackLikeTrigger(phase)) {

return quietStop("Swordbreak: original missed action was not attack-like.", { hideCard: true });

}

/* =========================

* Gate 2: the miss must be against the passive owner ("you")

* ========================= */

const ownerWasMissed =

sameUuid(triggerTargetUuid, ownerTokenDoc?.uuid) ||

sameUuid(triggerTargetActorUuid, ownerActor?.uuid);

if (!ownerWasMissed) {

return quietStop("Swordbreak: miss was not against passive owner.", { hideCard: true });

}

/* =========================

* Resolve original attacker

* ========================= */

const attackerActor = await resolveActor(triggerAttackerActorUuid ?? triggerAttackerUuid);

const attackerTokenDoc = await resolveTokenDoc(triggerAttackerUuid ?? triggerAttackerActorUuid);

if (!attackerActor) {

return quietStop("Swordbreak: could not resolve original attacker.", { hideCard: true });

}

/* =========================

* Proc roll

* ========================= */

const roll = randomPercentRoll();

const success = roll <= Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(PROC_CHANCE) || 0));

log("PROC ROLL", {

roll,

procChance: PROC_CHANCE,

success,

attacker: attackerActor?.name ?? null

});

if (!success) {

return quietStop("Swordbreak: proc failed.", { hideCard: true });

}

/* =========================

* Load Bane template

* ========================= */

const baneDoc = await resolveDoc(BANE_EFFECT_UUID);

if (!baneDoc || (baneDoc.documentName !== "ActiveEffect" && baneDoc.constructor?.name !== "ActiveEffect")) {

warn("Swordbreak: Bane ActiveEffect UUID could not be resolved.", { BANE_EFFECT_UUID, baneDoc });

return quietStop("Swordbreak: Bane template not found.", { hideCard: true });

}

const baneNameLc = low(baneDoc?.name ?? baneDoc?.label ?? "Bane");

/* =========================

* Duplicate guard

* ========================= */

if (SKIP_IF_TARGET_ALREADY_HAS_BANE) {

const alreadyHasBane = (attackerActor.effects ?? []).some(e => {

if (!e || e.disabled) return false;

const sameOrigin = sameUuid(e.origin, BANE_EFFECT_UUID);

const sameFlag = sameUuid(e.getFlag?.(FLAG_NS, FLAG_KEY), BANE_EFFECT_UUID);

const sameName = low(e.name ?? e.label ?? "") === baneNameLc;

return sameOrigin || sameFlag || sameName;

});

if (alreadyHasBane) {

log("Bane already present on attacker. Skipping re-apply.", {

attacker: attackerActor?.name ?? null

});

return quietStop("Swordbreak: attacker already has Bane.", { hideCard: true });

}

}

/* =========================

* Apply Bane directly

* ========================= */

let effData = null;

try {

effData = baneDoc.toObject();

} catch {

effData = foundry?.utils?.duplicate ? foundry.utils.duplicate(baneDoc) : null;

}

if (!effData || typeof effData !== "object") {

return quietStop("Swordbreak: failed to build Bane effect data.", { hideCard: true });

}

delete effData._id;

effData.origin = BANE_EFFECT_UUID;

effData.flags = effData.flags || {};

effData.flags[FLAG_NS] = {

...(effData.flags[FLAG_NS] || {}),

[FLAG_KEY]: BANE_EFFECT_UUID

};

await attackerActor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [effData]);

log("SUCCESS", {

owner: ownerActor?.name ?? null,

attacker: attackerActor?.name ?? null,

attackerToken: attackerTokenDoc?.name ?? null,

appliedEffect: baneDoc?.name ?? baneDoc?.label ?? "Bane"

});

/* =========================

* Success sound

* ========================= */

if (PLAY_SOUND_ON_SUCCESS) {

try {

if (typeof Sequencer !== "undefined") {

new Sequence()

.sound()

.file(SOUND_URL)

.volume(0.45)

.play();

} else if (globalThis.AudioHelper?.play) {

await AudioHelper.play(

{ src: SOUND_URL, volume: 0.45, autoplay: true, loop: false },

true

);

}

} catch (e) {

warn("Swordbreak: sound playback failed.", e);

}

}

/* =========================

* Success passive card

* ========================= */

p.meta.hidePassiveCard = false;

p.meta.passiveCardHidden = false;

p.meta.suppressPassiveCardUI = false;

await showPassiveCard("Swordbreak");

/* =========================

* Stop the rest of this passive skill's pipeline quietly

* ========================= */

return quietStop("Swordbreak handled directly.", { hideCard: false });
props.description: • When a creature 【⚔️Attack】you and missed, there's a chance to inflicts Bane to the attacker
props.name: Swordbreak
